$comment: Licence policy of the admin's production npm dependencies, checked by `npm run licenses` (the `Admin licenses` CI job, ADR 0022 §4, ADR 0012 §4). It follows deny.toml's rule: only licences that may be combined with AGPL-3.0-only, each with its reason. `allow` admits a licence for every package and holds only licences of ADR 0022 §4's allow-list (deny.toml's `allow`). Every other licence is an `exceptions` entry for one named package (any version), like deny.toml's crate exceptions, so a new package under such a licence fails until a PR names it and states the reason (ADR 0027). A licence is never in both. FSF = https://www.gnu.org/licenses/license-list.html.

allow.reason: The Expat licence: on the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences, so it combines with AGPL-3.0-only. Also on deny.toml's list.
On the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences. Also on deny.toml's list.
The FreeBSD licence: on the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences. Also on deny.toml's list.
The Modified BSD licence: on the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences. Also on deny.toml's list.
FSF: compatible with GPL version 3, and therefore combinable with AGPL-3.0-only. Also on deny.toml's list.

FSF: GPL-compatible through its secondary-licence clause (MPL-2.0 §3.3). The 'Incompatible With Secondary Licenses' variant has its own SPDX id, MPL-2.0-no-copyleft-exception, which is not allowed. Brought in by lightningcss, the CSS compiler of Vite and Tailwind. Also on deny.toml's list.

exceptions.reason: The Zero-clause BSD licence: on the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences; it grants every permission without conditions. The FSF adds that a copy whose copyright or licence notice was removed cannot safely be relied on; npm delivers tslib with its LICENSE.txt and the notice in each file. tslib is a production dependency through cmdk's dialog and the shadcn package's tooling. Scoped to this package, as deny.toml scopes 0BSD to quoted_printable (ADR 0027).

The Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0, an OSI-approved permissive licence that the FSF list does not name. It grants copyright and patent permission on one condition, that recipients get the licence text or a link to it, the same notice duty as MIT, so nothing in it conflicts with AGPL-3.0-only. isexe is build tooling of the shadcn package. Scoped to this package (ADR 0027).
The Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0, for the reason given for isexe. minimatch is build tooling of the shadcn package. Scoped to this package (ADR 0027).

The Inter variable font that the shadcn base-vega preset imports; its font files ship in admin/dist. FSF lists the SIL Open Font License 1.1 as a free licence for fonts. The font files are separate works served beside the program, an aggregate under AGPL-3.0 §5, not combined with it. Scoped to this package so that no code can arrive under a font licence (ADR 0027).

Browser-support data that browserslist reads at build time (through the shadcn package's tooling); none of it is bundled. FSF: CC BY 4.0 is compatible with all versions of the GNU GPL. It is a licence for data, not software, so it is scoped to this package (ADR 0027).
